definitions.gloss: the rings; still rings (men's gymnastics apparatus)
definitions.explanation: An apparatus in men's artistic gymnastics consisting of two rings hung from cables, on which the athlete performs swings, holds, and strength elements. Also the name of that event.

examples.japanese: つり{輪|わ}の{選手|せんしゅ}。
つり{輪|わ}で{金|きん}メダルを{取|と}った。
examples.english: He won the gold medal on the rings.

examples.japanese: つり{輪|わ}は{体操|たいそう}{男子|だんし}の{種目|しゅもく}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: The rings is one of the men's artistic gymnastics events.

notes:
Formed from つり ("hanging," from {吊|つ}る, to suspend) + {輪|わ} (ring). The hanging element is usually written in kana.

GYMNASTICS CONTEXT:
- One of the six men's artistic gymnastics events
- Prizes both swinging skill and great upper-body strength (e.g., the iron-cross hold)
- Other apparatus include {鉄棒|てつぼう} (horizontal bar) and {平行棒|へいこうぼう} (parallel bars)
